diagram_summary: Four word vectors (dog, cat, apple, banana) represented as 5-dimensional feature vectors with attributes: has_a_tail, is_eatable, has_4_legs, makes_sound, is_a_pet. Dog and cat vectors are similar (both have high tail and leg values), while apple and banana vectors differ significantly.
